targets.title: Pull-request gate rerun rate
targets.subject: ci.yml pull-request gate
targets.statement: At most 5 percent of the sampled ci.yml pull-request runs against main needed a rerun attempt, so a red gate is an observation and not noise.

targets.title: Pull-request final-head success rate
targets.subject: ci.yml pull-request gate
targets.statement: At least 95 percent of the sampled pull requests conclude green on their final head, so a red final head is a real failure rather than the steady state.

targets.title: State-mutating endpoints declare their error contract
targets.subject: error contract
targets.statement: Every state-mutating HTTP endpoint enumerates its failure modes in a declared error contract, so a caller never meets an undeclared error (INV-ERROR-001).
